title: ci: a Dependabot PR enqueued by dependabot-auto-merge.yml gets no merge_group runs and holds the merge-queue head for ~63 min per cycle
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 4 while tracking PRs #13489, #13493, #13494 and #13495 (all green, enqueued) to merge. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route. The fix surface is `.github/`, so it most likely belongs to `domain:devx`.

## Measured

**1. The merge group for Dependabot PR #13438 never gets a workflow run.** `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-13438-…` points at `c4a39eb`. `GET /actions/runs?head_sha=c4a39eb` returns **0 runs**, and its commit status is `pending` with 0 contexts. At the same time, every merge group enqueued by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` in the same window got exactly 5 runs. Query: `GET /actions/runs?event=merge_group&created=>2026-10-24T20:00Z`. It shows 5 runs each for pr-13028, 13472, 13480, 13481, 13483–13487, 13489, 13491 and 13493–13495, and **none** for pr-13438.

**2. The entry then times out, and the queue behind it waits the whole time.** #13438's timeline:

| enqueued (`added_to_merge_queue`, by `github-actions[bot]`) | removed (`removed_from_merge_queue`) | held |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-24 05:31Z | 06:35Z | 64 min |
| 2026-10-24 23:16Z | 2026-10-25 00:19Z | 63 min |
| 2026-10-25 02:34Z | still queued at 03:30Z | — |

Dependabot force-pushes (23:04Z, 02:22Z) and the workflow re-enqueues, so the cycle repeats. Right now five fleet PRs (#13491, #13489, #13493, #13494, #13495) sit behind it. #13489's group already completed green at about 02:52Z.

**3. No Dependabot PR has merged through the queue recently.** Five are open (#13434, #13435, #13437, #13438, #13439), and the recent closed ones (#11844, #11845, #13288) are unmerged.

## Reading (source, stated as inference)

`.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml` enqueues with `gh pr merge --auto --squash --match-head-commit "$GATED_SHA"` under `GITHUB_TOKEN` (the step "Enqueue for merge"). GitHub does not start workflow runs for events caused by `GITHUB_TOKEN`. The measurement fits that rule exactly: groups enqueued by the fleet App token run, and the one enqueued by `github-actions[bot]` does not. So the required merge-group checks never report, and the entry sits until the queue's check timeout removes it.

## Ask

Make a Dependabot-enqueued group actually run its checks. One way is to enqueue with an App or PAT token instead of `GITHUB_TOKEN`; another is not to enqueue Dependabot PRs from Actions at all. The choice is a CI-surface decision for whoever owns it. ⛔ Do not shorten the queue timeout or drop required checks to make it pass sooner.

## Reproduce

```
gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/git/matching-refs/heads/gh-readonly-queue --jq '.[].ref'
gh api "repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs?head_sha=<sha of the pr-13438 queue ref>" --jq .total_count   # 0
gh api "repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/13438/events?per_page=100" --jq '.[]|select(.event|test("merge_queue"))|"\(.created_at) \(.event) \(.actor.login)"'
```
